name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: Amazon Selling Partner API provides programmatic access to Amazon marketplace data for sellers, vendors, and developers.
auth_notes: An LWA access token expires one hour after it is issued.
access_notes: Third-party developers: $1,400/year annual fee active since Jan 31 2026; Basic tier includes 2.5M GET calls/month.

evidence.snippet: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing Amazon Selling Partner API tools for sellers.

To qualify, sellers must register as a private developer through Amazon’s Solution Provider Portal (or Seller Central’s developer console), generate their own SP-API credentials, and ensure the app is authorized only against their own account (Amazon permits up to 10 self-authorizations for private apps).
If your application is public, a selling partner must authorize your application.
